verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
As for me
I shall behold Your face in righteousness
I will be satisfied
In Your likeness

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I want to be just like You Lord
So as for me I will behold Your face

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
As for me
I will behold Your face in righteousness
I will be satisfied
When I awake with Your likeness
